$comment: Runtime silent-skip registry (issue #658 — ADR-054 section 9, enforced by tools/scripts/infra-skip-gate.ts). A suite listed here executes ZERO of its collected tests in at least one environment and is therefore reporting green without running. Listing it does not make that acceptable — it makes it VISIBLE and BOUNDED. Every entry needs: a `kind` from the closed enum (infra-gated | nightly-only | ci-inverse | pending-deletion — never claim a kind that isn't true, a dishonest reason is worse than a missing one), a `maxSkipped` CEILING (running more tests than declared is always fine; skipping more than declared fails), a `reviewBy` ISO date after which the entry FAILS the build, and a `reason` carrying a concrete reference in the same grammar ADR-054 annotations use. A reason without a real reference is decoration, not evidence, and is itself a violation. Prefer fixing the infrastructure over adding an entry.

entries.reason: ADR-054: #665 — only the true Supabase storage round-trip spec needs a reachable Supabase storage API with the case-documents and case-documents-quarantine buckets, so it truly executes only in preship-full-nightly. The orchestration, persistence and domain-contract specs run on every PR against local Postgres with InMemoryStorageAdapter.

ADR-054: #1114 — on 2026-11-01 it ran 5/5 against the local ephemeral DB (scripts/test-db.mjs run, which applies the migrations with migrate deploy), but CI main run 41239235781 skipped 5/5: the CI Integration Tests job builds its schema with db:push, which applies none of the migrations' RLS policies or GRANTs to `authenticated`, so the probe finds no policy and skips. Remove this entry when #1114 switches that job to migrate deploy.

ADR-054: #1117 — the local pre-ship coverage step cannot resolve @intelliflow/db from tests/integration/setup.ts, so createIsolatedTestPrismaClient() returns null and the suite skips 9/9 on every full-scope push (seen on 2026-11-01 for feat/embeddings-openrouter-free at aeac17a68). It runs in the integration-tests step and in CI. #1115 removed this entry; remove it again when #1117 makes the coverage run load the client.

ADR-054: #658 — IFC-174 accuracy benchmark. Double-gated on RUN_INTEGRATION_TESTS=true AND a live Ollama instance serving mistral at localhost:11434, neither of which exists on a dev box or in CI. Found by this gate's first full 16-project run, not by the original issue triage.

ADR-054: IFC-310 Step 9.5 — the NF-002 merge p95 benchmark is gated behind describe.skipIf(IS_CI) because the timing loop is flaky on shared CI runners, so it executes only on a developer machine via `pnpm --filter @intelliflow/api test contact-merge.bench`. Declared rather than forced to run: making a wall-clock benchmark gate CI would reintroduce exactly the flake the skip exists to avoid. Results land in artifacts/benchmarks/IFC-310-merge.json.
